openQuestions.question: Does boarding a tram or sky rail cost anything beyond the wait for the next service plus the ride?
openQuestions.why: The GDD sets no fare; only wait and ride are priced here and no other cost is invented.

openQuestions.question: Do the starting headways (T1/T2 180 s, S1 120 s) and dwells (trams 15 s, sky rail 20 s) stand?
openQuestions.why: The GDD gives none. They are Pulse's starting values [S], to be tuned by playtest.

openQuestions.question: Does the walk between linked stops (T1/circus to S1/circus, T1/records to T2/market, T2/parade to S1/harbour) count toward a journey's time?
openQuestions.why: Interchange walking is not in the timetable, so no cross-line journeys are listed.

openQuestions.question: Do services run for the whole mission clock, and are there any limits on boarding?
openQuestions.why: Operating hours and limits are undecided; none is invented.

openQuestions.question: Should S1 Skyport be a timetabled station, and should T1/T2 extend past the sheet?
openQuestions.why: The plan text lists Skyport (530,0), but the station list omits it, so it is untimetabled. Termini are off-sheet.

notes: Speeds [S], starting values: trams 6 m/s (about 22 km/h); sky rail 8 m/s (about 29 km/h). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded half up, acceleration and braking folded in.
Journey sec = ride plus dwell at each intermediate stop. It excludes the wait for the first service, which runs from 0 up to one headway: T1/T2 up to 180 s, S1 up to 120 s.
Lines are double track, so run times match both ways and reverse journeys have the same sec. All listed journeys are single-line, so via is empty.
Conflict: T2 market to harbour-court is listed as 327 m, but chainages 1108 minus 782 give 326 m. I used the listed 327 m (55 s; 54 s at 326 m). Datum to confirm.
Conflict: S1 harbour is at x 332 in the stop list but 340 in the plan notes. Datum to reconcile. Skyport and the loop are untimetabled (no chainage given).
